units.text: First Joyful Mystery. The Annunciation.
Picture the angel Gabriel coming to Mary in Nazareth. He tells her that she will bear Jesus, the Son of the Most High. Mary freely accepts God's call.
Picture Nazareth at dawn, with a quiet, simple room.
Picture Mary at prayer, listening with a peaceful heart.
Picture Gabriel arriving before Mary with a message from God.
Picture Mary listening as Gabriel tells her she will bear the Savior.
Picture Mary pausing in wonder and asking how this will happen.
Picture the Holy Spirit overshadowing Mary.
Picture Mary freely preparing to say yes to God.
Picture Mary freely accepting God's call to become the mother of Jesus.
Picture the Son of God becoming a child in Mary's womb.

units.text: Picture Mary remaining in the quiet room after the angel leaves.
Second Joyful Mystery. The Visitation.
Picture Mary visiting Elizabeth. Elizabeth rejoices, and the child in her womb leaps for joy. Mary praises God for his mercy.
Picture Mary setting out from Nazareth to visit Elizabeth.
Picture Mary traveling through the hills toward Elizabeth's home.
Picture Mary entering the house and greeting Elizabeth.
Picture John leaping in Elizabeth's womb at Mary's greeting.
Picture Elizabeth welcoming Mary and blessing the child she carries.
Picture Mary praising God in the Magnificat.
Picture Mary staying beside Elizabeth through the months of waiting.
Picture Mary helping with the ordinary work of the household.
Picture the two mothers sharing the quiet moments of the day.
Picture Mary returning home after her visit.
Third Joyful Mystery. The Nativity.
Picture Mary and Joseph in Bethlehem. Jesus is born and laid in a manger. Shepherds hear the angels' good news and come to find him.
Picture Mary and Joseph arriving in Bethlehem.
Picture Mary and Joseph finding no place in the lodging.
Picture the humble place where Mary will give birth.
Picture the newborn Jesus wrapped in swaddling clothes.
Picture Mary laying Jesus gently in a manger.
Picture shepherds outside at night, hearing the angel's announcement.
Picture the shepherds coming to see the child.
Picture Mary and Joseph welcoming the shepherds beside the manger.
Picture the shepherds kneeling before the child.
Picture Mary keeping these events in her heart.
Fourth Joyful Mystery. The Presentation.
Picture Mary and Joseph bringing Jesus to the Temple. Simeon receives the child and praises God. Anna gives thanks and speaks about him to those awaiting redemption.
Picture Mary and Joseph bringing Jesus into the Temple.
Picture Mary and Joseph making their humble offering.
Picture Simeon taking the child into his arms.
Picture Simeon praising God for the salvation he has waited to see.
Picture Mary listening as Simeon speaks of the sorrow ahead.
Picture Mary holding Jesus close as she receives Simeon's words.
Picture Anna giving thanks and speaking about the child.
Picture the family standing together in the Temple.
Picture Mary and Joseph leaving the Temple with Jesus.
Picture the family returning to their ordinary life in Nazareth.
Fifth Joyful Mystery. Finding Jesus in the Temple.
Picture Mary and Joseph searching for Jesus in Jerusalem. After three days they find him in the Temple, listening and asking questions. He returns with them to Nazareth.
Picture Mary and Joseph beginning the journey home from Jerusalem.
Picture Mary and Joseph discovering Jesus is not among the travelers.
Picture Mary and Joseph returning to Jerusalem to search for Him.
Picture the anxious days of looking for Jesus.
Picture Jesus sitting among the teachers in the Temple.
Picture Mary speaking to Jesus after their long search.
Picture Jesus speaking of His Father's house.
Picture Jesus returning to Nazareth with Mary and Joseph.
Picture Mary keeping His words in her heart.
Picture Jesus living with His family in Nazareth.
